description: Stop a stream (standing work at a weekly rate, set with stream_set) that no longer earns its place. Say why in plain words; the owner reads it. It needs an act key.

key.description: The stream's key, as stream_set gave it or situation_read lists it.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

reason.description: Why it stops, in plain words; the owner reads it.

name: stream_stop
title: Stream stop
